title: Open Neural Network Exchange (ONNX) Announced
summary: Microsoft announced the Open Neural Network Exchange (ONNX) format on 7 September 2017 in conjunction with Facebook, describing it as a shared model representation intended to support interoperability across AI frameworks.
significance: A first-party, day-precision public-announcement milestone for an open model-representation project explicitly co-developed by Microsoft and Facebook, distinct from ONNX 1.0 becoming production-ready later in December 2017.

verification.note: Microsoft's first-party announcement dated September 7, 2017 explicitly states that Microsoft and Facebook were announcing ONNX together and had co-developed it as an open source project. Meta's later first-party ONNX 1.0 release post independently states that an early version was released in September 2017 and distinguishes that earlier milestone from the production-ready first version announced in December. This candidate records only the September 7 public-announcement milestone. It does not infer an invention date, development-start date, development geography, universal priority, ancestry, influence, causality, or relationship edges.
